summary: This study is testing how well a new combination of diabetes drugs works in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, which is a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. Participants will take either cofrogliptin every two weeks or daily linagliptin, added to their existing treatments of metformin and dapagliflozin. The trial plans to enroll 170 participants to see how the treatments affect long-term blood sugar levels over a 24-week period.
